scripts.android:dev-release-apk: yarn copy-env-dev && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDevRelease && cd .. && echo 'find APK in android/app/build/outputs/apk/dev/release'
scripts.android:uat-release-apk: yarn copy-env-uat && cd android && ./gradlew assembleUatRelease && cd .. && echo 'find APK in android/app/build/outputs/apk/uat/release'
scripts.android:prod-release-apk: yarn copy-env-prod && cd android && ./gradlew assembleProdRelease && cd .. && echo 'find APK in android/app/build/outputs/apk/prod/release'
scripts.android:prod-release-aab: yarn copy-env-prod && cd android && ./gradlew bundleProdRelease && cd .. && echo 'find AAB in android/app/build/outputs/apk/prod/release'
scripts.android:prod-release-install: yarn copy-env-prod && yarn android:prod-release-apk && adb -s 089773729L003084 install android/app/build/outputs/apk/prod/release/app-prod-release.apk && adb -s 089773729L003084 shell am start -n com.notemd/com.notemd.MainActivity
scripts.copy-env-dev: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.env.dev')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.dev', '.env'); console.log('📁 .env.dev copied to .env');"
scripts.copy-env-uat: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.env.uat')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.uat', '.env'); console.log('📁 .env.uat copied to .env');"
scripts.copy-env-prod: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('.env.prod')) fs.copyFileSync('.env.prod', '.env'); console.log('📁 .env.prod copied to .env');"
